Proposition

Let Omega be a bounded domain with smooth boundary. Every concave solution of the elliptic equation in Omega extends smoothly to the closure.

Step 3. The affine operator \(P_{01380013}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle P_{01380013} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via perturbative interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
